text:
maya (acct exec): Need quick approval - SatelliteCare asking for an 8-week pilot at 70% off hosted inference. They say it's for a nationwide rollout pilot. :pray:
jon (finance ops): 70% is above thresholds. What's the pilot spend and expected conversion ARR?
maya (acct exec): Pilot = ~3.5M tokens -> list ~$105k. At 70% they'd pay ~$31.5k; concession ~$73.5k. If converted, sales projects ~$420k ARR.
liam (revops): Recommend pilot credit cap = $50k, require LOI with decision date, and onboarding fee $3k prepaid. GL: 5350 for marketing concessions.
anna (head of finance): We cannot approve >50% without VP signoff. Conditional: approve up to 50% with $50k cap, $3k onboarding fee, LOI, SOW, and legal signoff. Anything above goes to VP.
rachel (legal): We'll need SOW, data handling addendum (PHI check), and reseller/partner docs if any. Review ETA 48-72h.
maya (acct exec): OK - I'll ask customer for LOI and draft SOW. tagging @dealbot to create ticket.
dealbot: /dealdesk create customer=SatelliteCare pilot_discount=50% pilot_cap=50000 onboarding_fee=3000 expected_ARR=420000 notes="conditional approval pending docs"
financebot: Checklist: deal desk URL, LOI pdf, SOW, GL code confirmation. Finance will finalize concession memo after receipt.
jon (finance ops): I'll prepare concession memo template and hold approval until docs land.
maya (acct exec): Thanks all 44d Will upload LOI today.
